description: The archetype tree apps are declared against. Declarations only: nothing in the code reads it yet except the registry test. The layers are app > feature > service > aspect > concept; this file holds the two lowest ones.

aspect.title: Aspect
aspect.description: Root archetype. Something that affects the scene or the bather without being a thing you can point at: weather, clothing, a nostalgic filter, the time of day.

concept.title: Concept
concept.description: A sub kind of aspect: a tangible thing, a declaration of a kind of movement or object (soaring, ornaments). Apps implement or inherit a concept.

soaring.title: Soaring
soaring.description: The concept of moving through the world: swimming, swinging, flying, bodyflight and the ride are inheritances of it.

ornament.title: Ornament
ornament.description: The concept of decorative objects: lights (neon edges, string lights), decorations and floating rings implement it.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Aspect: what the sky and air do (rain, snow, wind, clouds, aurora).

time.title: Time
time.description: Aspect: the time of day and its light.

clothing.title: Clothing
clothing.description: Aspect: layers the bather wears (the hood and float suit).

nostalgia.title: Nostalgia
nostalgia.description: Aspect: looks borrowed from the past, such as the 90s retro filter.

water.title: Water
water.description: Aspect: how the water itself looks and behaves for the viewer (the underwater fog).

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Aspect: settings that move or shape the camera (drift, tornado spin). No app declares only this yet.
